description: sdi.isprambiente.it: coastal flood and storm surge hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sdi.isprambiente.it. Coverage: the area served by sdi.isprambiente.it. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about coastal flood and storm surge hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Linea di costa 2020 v2.0 - Dataset; Linea di costa 2000 - View Service; Linea di costa 2006 - View Service; Linea di costa - View Service. Formats seen: WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
